raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions mixes two source time zones. The 327 rows with source_tz='UTC' (exactly batch 13) carry UTC timestamps, while the America/Chicago rows are local time (they start at about 06:00 local). silver_transactions casts txn_ts without normalizing, so the UTC rows are shifted about 6 hours early, which produces the 00:00-06:00 transactions on 2026-01-18 and misassigns their txn_date. Converting UTC rows to America/Chicago local time, which is the convention the other rows use, should align all transactions and fix the dates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH t AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', txn_ts)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM t;"}}
